subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should a channel publish the generic ChannelAccountSnapshot.processRestartRequired contract, or should Telegram request supervised process replacement through a narrow injected runtime seam?
rationale: This is a new plugin-facing process-control API with cross-channel semantics; source review can assess correctness, but only the channel and gateway owners can choose the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Use a narrow restart-request seam
options.body: Keep Telegram-owned wedge detection and inject an explicit supervised process-restart request capability without making diagnostic snapshot state a generic restart command.

options.title: Approve the generic snapshot contract
options.body: Retain processRestartRequired as a documented shared channel API after confirming its lifecycle, authorization, clearing, and compatibility expectations for external plugins.

options.title: Defer whole-process recovery
options.body: Do not merge the restart contract yet and keep the linked recovery issue open until a safer hard-cancellation boundary exists below the gateway process.

recommendation.title: Use a narrow restart-request seam
recommendation.body: Keep Telegram-owned wedge detection and inject an explicit supervised process-restart request capability without making diagnostic snapshot state a generic restart command.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies this person with Telegram subsystem ownership, and the PR discussion already routes the exact contract choice to them.
